# <span id="aanchor162"></span> Unrolled Locations

## Tab Details

#### Unrolled Locations Tab

As data is imported or edited within FLOWCAL, the data is queued to roll. Meter rollups will queue the appropriate location rollups, if any, after rolling meter data. These will display on the **Unrolled Locations** tab.

The rollup service calculates hourly, daily, and monthly data for meters and locations from the periodic values. The resulting data is used for reporting purposes and can be viewed within one of the rollup viewers or by running a report or export.

The Unrolled Locations tab displays data for locations that have not rolled or were not rolled successfully. Data that did not roll successfully will display with a status of "Postponed".

To remove warnings about data failing to roll when running reports, select the desired locations and click the **Ignore** button. The data will refresh and the selected locations will have a status of "Ignored" and will not be re-rolled. If the problem that caused rollup failure has been corrected, select the desired locations and click the **Queue** button. The data will refresh and the selected location will have a status of "In Queue". You may then try the rollup again.

#### Columns

- **Location Number** - Displays the location number.
- **Location Name** - Displays the location name.
- **Start Date** - The first date for which data will be rolled for the location.
- **End Date** - The last date for which data will be rolled for the location.
- **Status**
  - **Ignored** - Data for the location was queued for rolling, but failed. Someone selected the data and clicked the **Ignore** button. It will not be re-rolled until it has a status of "In Queue".
  - **In Queue** - Data for the location has been placed in the queue, but the rollups service has not rolled it yet. Clicking **Queue** or the **Ignore** button on "In Queue" data will have no effect.
  - **Postponed** - The rollups service tried to roll data for this location, but an error occurred. More information about the reason for the failure can be found in the log files.
- **GMS Date** - The date on which the data was queued to be rolled.

#### Buttons

- **On Demand** - Set a location to roll on demand within the Location Editor. This queues the data for rollup, but the rollup will not process until it is initiated from the Unrolled Locations tab of the Service Queues. When a location is set to roll on demand, clicking the **On Demand** button makes these records visible from the Unrolled Locations tab and updates the status of these entries to "In Queue".
- **Hold** - Put a record in the queue on hold. The records will not be processed until you change the status back to "In Queue".
- **Ignore** - Ignore locations that were postponed.
- **Queue** - Change the status of a record to "In Queue". Rollups will try to re-roll the data.
- **Refresh** - Refresh the display to check the status of rollups (display does not refresh automatically).
- **Exit** - Close the screen.
